title: Five Worlds Below and Five Fathers Above
description: A paired anatomy. T6 anatomizes selfhood's fivefold articulation of the natural mind — five worlds of darkness with their kings, their bodies (gold, iron, bronze, lead, dark-stone), their tastes, the smoke as wellspring of contention. T7 exposes the five Fathers — the five registers at which the Lord can be recognized as he goes forth in successive emanations — Father of Greatness, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Mind of Light, Form of Light. The section is the mirror: what self-love articulates in five complete aspects is what divine love accommodates in five successive degrees.
